name: dumbbell seated military press in out leg raise on floor
description: A seated overhead press combined with in and out leg movements. It works the shoulders and the lower abs together.
instructions: Sit on the floor leaning back slightly, dumbbells at your shoulders.
Pull your knees in, then extend the legs out as the weights stay up.
Lower the dumbbells to your shoulders.
Repeat, keeping your back long and core braced.
